build_get_ap_transforms: build a composed transform pipeline from config with color jitter, gaussian blur, and random gamma
create_colorjitter_batch: create a ColorJitter transform that applies jitter to a batch of tensor images concatenated horizontally
create_random_gamma_transform: create a RandomGamma transform that applies random gamma correction to tensor images
create_random_gaussian_blur: create a RandomGaussianBlur transform that conditionally applies PIL Gaussian blur to image batches
create_topilimage_batch: create a ToPILImage transform that converts a batch of tensor images to PIL images
